parameters.content:
## WF08-08 Error Handling and Recovery
Two ways in. (1) n8n Error Trigger: another AURUM workflow crashed; the error is reported to AURUM, which classifies it and retries within its retry limit or dead-letters it. (2) AURUM webhook: a tracked run failed, timed out, was dead-lettered or recovered; its state is recorded once and escalated to the dashboard when it is not being retried. This workflow sends nothing again itself and never retries anything about a trade.
